name: tar-archiver
description: A cross-runtime POSIX ustar tar archiver and extractor. Encodes files with metadata (name, mode, uid, gid, mtime, size) into raw binary 512-byte aligned tar archive payloads, computes standard octal checksums, and parses tar archives back into file record structures.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to create or read standard POSIX tar archives in-memory using pure Uint8Array operations, without external system commands or node-tar dependencies.
